findings.issue: valueThresholdPct is passed to tenths() without the finitePct() check the sibling fields get, so a hand-built input with a non-finite value would give a NaN margin instead of a RangeError.
findings.evidence: No reachable untrusted path: every gradeDecision caller (golden.ts:511, golden.ts:659 via advise(), playtest/advice-check.ts:104) grades a freshly computed recommendPostflop result, where the field is the literal 50 | 65. Stored graded examples are re-advised and not read back as recommendations.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. (1) Hidden-card isolation still holds. BOT_ADVICE only sets opponentRanges:'actions'. estimateOpponentRanges(view, observed) reads only the bot's own PlayerView, plus observed stats that bots never get: adviceOptions() drops observedOpponents, so it is undefined and the default [] is used. Spreading BOT_ADVICE first lets an explicit opponentRanges override it but cannot add observed stats. (2) The numeric paths are safe. The engine caps call.amount at min(owe, stack) (hand.ts:360), so hero.stack - callAmount >= 0 and riverBet >= 0. When the bot is all-in or has a zero stack after the call, riverBet = 0. When no opponent can bet (payers = 0), riverBet = 0. The denominator pot + callAmount + 2R is >= callAmount > 0 whenever owed > 0, and nothing is computed when owed = 0, so there is no division by zero or NaN/Infinity. (3) Old records stay compatible. requiredCountsRiverBet and valueThresholdPct are optional and fall back to false or 50, and there is no change to storage, network, dependencies or randomness.
